MADE SOMETHING?
FOR THE FILMMAKERS

Submit your film

Independent Black film deserves an audience that shows up on purpose. Send us your work. If the Kitchen selects it, your film gets a seat on the shelves and in front of the community. Founding window: submissions are free.

Your rights stay yours, always. Submitting doesn’t transfer anything and doesn’t guarantee selection or review. We’ll only use your link to screen the film and will contact you before any listing goes live.

Build this with us

Help write the canon.

Well Seasoned is built by the culture — and that includes you. If you review film or write about it, there’s a seat at this table: real bylines, human editors, nothing bought. This is where the next generation of Black film criticism gets its platform.

Verified critics of the culture. Your scores move the official Kitchen number on every film and run beside your byline and outlet — a seat that’s earned, never bought.

Every title is real — films, directors, cast, runtimes, and where-to-watch via TMDB. Scores are earned, never bought: The Kitchen is verified critics of the culture, The Table is the community's live vote, and the seal only lands when both agree. Content pepper flags (language, violence, sexual content) are estimated from ratings and content keywords, not a scene-by-scene guide.
